newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Everbright placement hits snag.
newsitem.headline: China Everbright placement hits snag.

text.p: China Everbright-IHD Pacific Ltd's attempts to raise funds through a placement of new and old shares appears to have run into problems, market sources said on Wednesday.
Brokers said offers last week for placement shares in China Everbright-IHD Pacific had been withdrawn this week. "It was on again, off again," said one.
China Everbright-IHD officials said no one was available for comment. Trading in its shares was suspended on Monday.
Shares in sister companies China Everbright Technology Ltd were also suspended on Monday and China Everbright International Ltd was suspended on Tuesday.
"It appears that the stock exchange wants a full explanation of what the money is to be used for," said one broker. The stock exchange said it had no comment on individual company issues.

China Everbright Holdings -IHD Pacific Ltd had originally intended to place a total combination of 175 million old and new shares at HK$10.75 a share, raising a total of HK$1.88 billion, market sources said.
The shares were offered in Hong Kong and London, market sources said.
The funds were likely to be used to acquire a 20 percent stake in Everbright Bank of China, which is 51 percent held by the company's parent China Everbright Group Ltd, analysts said.
The funds raised by China Everbright were also to be used to acquire a stake in casual wear maker and retailer Theme International Holdings Ltd, market sources said.
Shares in Theme International were also suspended on Monday.
China Everbright-IHD Pacific has yet to issue any statement regarding the placement.
